findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed there to be time-temperature control for safety (TCS) food to be stored at room temperature. Foods were 6 cans of whipped cream. Discussed with PIC, and PIC discarded the whipped cream. Ensure that TCS food is stored at 41F or below.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed 3 packages of sliced ham to be out of date. Discussed with PIC, and PIC discarded the meat immediately. Along with this, many items were past their “best by” date, and they were all voluntarily discarded immediately. Ensure that no food is kept and sold past their use-by date on the container.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the facility to be storing a wet mop with the head inside a bucket. Discussed with PIC, and PIC placed the mop head over the edge of a wringer basket to allow for quick drying. Ensure that mops are always stored in a manner that allows them to air-dry.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed dry wall missing near toilet in employee bathroom. Observed ceiling tiles missing in the employee bathroom. Repair before next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16  (C) Mop was found stored incorrectly in-between use. Mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.  Reference 6-501.16. 

Observed mop to be stored within mop bucket. Mops should be hung in a manner that allows drip drying and/or air drying in-between uses. Discussed importance with PIC. COS.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.citation_text:
6-305.11  (C) Employee clothing and personal items were found stored improperly. Food establishments shall A) Provide designated dressing rooms or dressing areas for employees that routinely change their clothes in the establishment; B) Provide lockers or other suitable facilities for the orderly storage of employees' clothing and other possessions. Reference 6-305.11. . 

Observed employee food within reach of customers in the walk-in cooler towards the back. This is a repeat violation from the 11/22/2019 inspection. Discussed again the importance of storing personal, employee food away from customer items and/or reach. Ensure designated area is maintained for employee items.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.citation_text:
6-403.11 Designated Areas - Employee Accommodations for eating/drinking/smoking (C)

Observed employee food with in reach of customer area of reach-in alcohol cooler. All employee food and drinks must be kept separate from customer products and reach. Also observed, "Freddy's", drink cup behind milk for sale in separate reach-in cooler. Discussed with PIC.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Drying Mops (C)

Observed wet mop improperly drying in back employee room. Mops must be air dried in a manner that allows mop to drip dry (ex. handing upside down). COS.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability (Pf)

Observed lack of hand soap at employee bathroom handsink. COS.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision (Pf)

Observed lack of paper towels at employee bathroom handsink. COS.

These are both repeat violations from the last routine inspection in 2017.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
CORRECTED: Observed boxes of chips and drinks stored on the floor in the back room. Store all food at least six inches off the floor. The boxes of chips were removed and placed on a shelf during the inspection to correct the violation.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towel and soap in the employee restroom. Provide soap and paper towel in the employee restroom.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: Eight 14oz bottles of chocolate milk in the glass door cooler are 48F. 750-250  All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 41°F or below while on display and service. The bottles of milk have been taken to the back and discarded down the drain.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: The employee restroom is badly soiled. 750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials. Clean and maintain clean. The restroom has been cleaned.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
SEE LAST INSPECTION FOR DETAILS.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: A thermometer is not readily visible for the walk in cooler which holds milk. 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F. Provide thermometer for walk in cooler.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: The mop sink in the back hall is observed to drip even thought the water is turned off. 750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code. Repair sink so that it does not drip and provide a water source for insects and rodents.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
Day light is visible under the front door. The threshold piece has been crushed and therefore the door is no longer tight fitting.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects by tight fitting self closing doors. 
Repair door to be tight fitting.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: Walls in the following areas have holes, is in disrepair and areas of visible mold: 1) behind the mop sink 2) in the rest room behind the stool 3) in the rest room the wall with the return vent has a hole and the vent is uncovered 3) Also, the hand sink in the restroom is not sealed to the wall. The wall with the hand sink has a large hole where the plumbing comes out of the wall. The ceiling tiles are in disrepair or missing in the rest room. Also the ceiling in the walk in cooler has areas of accumulated soil along with the fan covers of the compressor units. 750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment:
Employees are scooping ice into styrofoam cups. A hand sink is not available in the facility.
750 -510  Employees shall thoroughly wash their hands and arms before starting work and when necessary to keep them clean.
Provide a hand sink to wah hands.  The cups of ice were discarded. The facility will not sell or provide cups of ice for free.

findings.title: Dishwashing facilities designed, constructed, operated (1. wash 2. rinse 3. sanitize)
findings.comment:
Employees are scooping ice into styrofoam cups. There is not a three-compartment sink to wash, rinse and sanitize a scoop.
750-820a For manual washing, rinsing and sanitizing of utensils and equipment, a sink with no fewer then three compartments shall be provided and used.
Provide a 3-compartment sink.  The cups of ice were discarded. The facility will not sell or provide cups of ice for free.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
Employees are scooping ice into styrofoam cups. There is not a three-compartment sink to wash, rinse and sanitize a scoop.
750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).
Provide a 3-compartment sink. The cups of ice were discarded.  The facility will not sell or provide cups of ice for free.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment:
Employees are scooping ice into styrofoam cups. A hand sink is not available in the facility.
750-1120(a) Lavatories shall be at least the number required by law, shall be installed according to law and shall be located to permit convenient use by all employees in food preparation areas and utensil washing areas.
Provide a hand sink to wah hands.  The cups of ice were discarded. The facility will not sell or provide cups of ice for free.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Did not observed thermometers in the ice cream freezer, 2-door reach in freezer or the walk in cooler.  Provide thermometers in the coolers holding potentially hazardous food.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed numerous containers of employee food including unwashed grapes, boasted chicken and pots/containers from home, above food for sale.  Store employee food separate from food for sale.  Corrected:  The employee food was moved.
750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Repeat: Observed debris on the bottom shelf of the 2-door freezer.  Clean and sanitize the shelf.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Repeats: 1.The bathroom door is not self-closing.  Provide a self-closing door.  2.Did not observe soap in the restroom.  Provide soap.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.
750-1120 All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Repeats:  1.The ceiling in the bathroom has water damage.  Repair the leak and replace the ceiling tiles.  2.The bathroom sink is not caulked to the wall.  Caulk the sink to the wall.
New: 3.Observed an accumulation of dust on the fan guards in the walk in cooler.  Clean the fan guards.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.
